department: Department of Cell and Molecular Biology

app_fee.value: No application fee for the Cell and Molecular Biology PhD.

gre_general.value: The School of Science and Engineering does not require the GRE.

gre_subject.value: The GRE is not required for School of Science and Engineering applicants.

toefl_min.value: Cell and Molecular Biology requires TOEFL iBT 100 from applicants whose country does not use English as its official language.
toefl_min.quote: A minimum TOEFL score of 600 on the paper version, 250 on the computer version, or 100 on the Internet based version is required.

ielts_min.value: School of Science and Engineering minimum: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall.
ielts_min.quote: Minimum overall band score on IELTS Academic: 7.0.

supervisor.value: Advised to identify at least one faculty member whose research matches theirs before applying.
supervisor.quote: it is helpful to identify at least one faculty member who has a background and research in the area in which you are most interested in studying

funding.value: The school offers teaching or research assistantships to all incoming PhD students.
funding.quote: offers Teaching Assistantships and/or Research Assistantships to all incoming PhD students

entry_route.value: Applicants need an undergraduate degree before starting; no master's is listed as required.
entry_route.quote: Earned an undergraduate degree from an accredited institution prior to the first semester of proposed graduate study

deadline.value: Ecology and Evolutionary Biology closes December 1, 2026; Cell and Molecular Biology closes January 1, 2027.

also.quote: Applications for Fall 2027 admission into the Cell and Molecular Biology Doctoral Program will be accepted from October 1, 2026 through January 1, 2027.

notes: Covers two School PhDs. Cell and Molecular Biology page: deadline January 1, 2027 and TOEFL 100. Ecology and Evolutionary Biology: only the School table deadline (December 1, 2026) was available; its department admissions page returned 403.
name: Cell and Molecular Biology, PhD (with Ecology and Evolutionary Biology, PhD)
